mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates demand-driven housing boom coinciding with supply contraction, signaling strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth that produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and falling INDPRO fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), policy rate hikes compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000,000 units for three consecutive months, it signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, signaling reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth that produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 95.0), manufacturing sector slowdown signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings declines, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
